name: Vessel
gap: A body that can hold a curse
desc: Someone who swallowed what should have killed them. A curse sleeps inside, and the body has grown tough enough to hold it.
traits: Eating a cursed finger or cursed object gives Strength I for 60 s instead of poisoning you
+4 max health and fast natural healing
Below 20% health the curse stirs: Nausea for 3 s (once a minute)

abilities.name: Iron Gut
abilities.text: Eat any cursed or rotten item safely and gain food from it for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Inner Voice
abilities.text: The curse inside points to the nearest special-grade object or boss within 128 blocks for 30 s. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Superhuman Leap
abilities.text: Jump 6 blocks high and take no fall damage from it. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Swap Out
abilities.text: For 10 s the curse takes over: you can't be stunned or slowed, but you can't use items. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shrug Off
abilities.text: Remove every harmful effect and heal 4. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Divergent Fist
abilities.text: A punch that hits twice: once on contact and a cursed-energy echo 0.5 s later. 30 s cooldown.

name: Cursed Spirit
source: Cursed Fate cursed spirits, Mahito, Jogo
desc: Not born but condensed out of human fear. Sorcerers hunt them, ordinary people can't see them, and they don't truly die while the fear remains.
traits: Players without cursed energy (no Cursed Fate technique) can't see you clearly: you're shown faded
Immune to poison and hunger drains 50% slower
Healing from food and potions is halved; you heal by absorbing fear (kills heal 2)

abilities.name: Unseen
abilities.text: Become invisible to mobs and to players without a technique for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Feed on Fear
abilities.text: Villagers and passive mobs within 12 blocks panic; you heal 1 for each one for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reform
abilities.text: When you'd die, reform from your cursed energy at 4 health instead (once every 20 minutes).

abilities.name: Phase Through
abilities.text: Pass through one block-thick walls for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Curse Sense
abilities.text: See every cursed spirit, sorcerer and cursed object within 48 blocks for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Idle Transfiguration Touch
abilities.text: Your next hit within 10 s twists the target: Slowness III and Weakness II for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

name: Heavenly Restricted
gap: No cursed energy, a perfect body
desc: Born with no cursed energy at all. The universe paid them back in flesh: senses, speed and strength beyond any sorcerer.
traits: +15% movement and attack speed, +2 armour
Can see cursed spirits and invisible creatures within 16 blocks
Can't use Cursed Fate techniques or domains, and mana is capped at 20%

abilities.name: Keen Senses
abilities.text: Every creature within 32 blocks shows through walls for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Inventory Curse
abilities.text: Open a 9-slot pocket that holds weapons (a cursed spirit you carry). 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Wall Run
abilities.text: Run along walls for 3 s. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Domain Blind Spot
abilities.text: For 10 s, domain expansions and sure-hit effects can't find you. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hunter's Nose
abilities.text: Track the player or mob you name: a pointer for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.text: Dash 10 blocks forward, hitting the first enemy for your weapon's damage. 20 s cooldown.

name: Death Painting
source: Choso and the Death Painting wombs
desc: A cursed womb made flesh, half-human and half-curse. Their blood is a weapon and their brothers are everything.
traits: Immune to bleeding and poison
Blood regenerates: heal 1 every 5 s while above half hunger
Fire deals 25% more damage (blood boils)

abilities.name: Blood Sense
abilities.text: Sense every wounded creature (below full health) within 32 blocks for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Coagulate
abilities.text: Stop all bleeding on you and allies within 6, healing each 4. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Flowing Red Scale
abilities.text: Speed I, Strength I and Haste I for 20 s, costing 4 health. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Brother's Bond
abilities.text: Mark one ally: you always know where they are, and you feel it when they're hurt, for 20 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Bridge
abilities.text: Harden your blood into a 6-block bridge ahead that lasts 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Piercing Blood
abilities.text: Fire a compressed blood beam in a line (16 blocks), 8 damage, costing 2 health. 45 s cooldown.

name: Cursed Corpse
desc: A stitched-together body with a cursed core instead of a heart. Some have more than one core, and more than one personality.
traits: Don't need to breathe; immune to poison and hunger effects
+4 max health and +2 armour
Can't eat cooked food for effects: you're fed by cursed energy (eat bones, wool and cursed objects)

abilities.name: Core Swap
abilities.text: Switch between two cores: one gives Speed I, one gives Resistance I. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Stitch Up
abilities.text: Repair yourself with string or wool: heal 6. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Plush Body
abilities.text: Take no fall damage for 30 s and bounce off the ground. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hibernate Core
abilities.text: Stand still to heal 2 a second for 10 s, but you can't move. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Puppet Friend
abilities.text: Sew a small cursed corpse that follows you and carries 9 items for 10 minutes. 15 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Drumming Beat
abilities.text: Your next hit within 10 s ignores armour and knocks back hard. 45 s cooldown.

name: Disaster Spirit
desc: A curse born from humanity's fear of the earth, the forest or the sea. Choose which disaster you embody when you pick the race (fire, forest or ocean); one ability follows it.
traits: Immune to the damage of your element (fire, thorns and poison plants, or drowning)
Your element's biome heals you 1 every 5 s
The opposite element hurts you 25% more (water, fire or lightning)

abilities.name: Elemental Body
abilities.text: Fire: walk on lava. Forest: plants grow under your feet. Ocean: swim like a fish. For 30 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Nature's Ear
abilities.text: Feel every creature touching your element within 32 blocks (in fire, in plants, in water) for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Calamity Weather
abilities.text: Fire: clear skies. Forest: rain. Ocean: rain and high waves. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shape the Land
abilities.text: Fire: turn stone to magma. Forest: grow a tree or vines. Ocean: make a water pool. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Disaster Shell
abilities.text: Gain 8 absorption made of your element for 15 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Elemental Burst
abilities.text: Fire: a volcano erupts under the target. Forest: a cursed bud drains it. Ocean: a fish swarm hits it. 8 damage. 60 s cooldown.

name: Incarnate
gap: An old soul in a new body
desc: A sorcerer from a thousand years ago, sleeping in a body that once belonged to someone else. They remember techniques no one alive knows.
traits: Gain 25% more experience from killing sorcerers and bosses
Speak the old tongue: read enchantment and spell scrolls without a lectern
Villagers don't trust you: trades cost 15% more

abilities.name: Ancient Memory
abilities.text: Learn: the next spell scroll or skill book you read gives double experience. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Possess
abilities.text: Take control of a weaker mob you look at (below 20 health) for 20 s, seeing through it. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Old Ways
abilities.text: Craft one cursed tool or talisman without a crafting table. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Barrier
abilities.text: Raise a simple barrier (a curtain) around a 10-block area for 60 s: mobs can't see in. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Host's Instinct
abilities.text: For 10 s, see the last 3 places you died or were badly hurt. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Forgotten Technique
abilities.text: Cast a random technique from a past life: a lightning strike, a fire burst or a gravity slam. 60 s cooldown.

name: Six Eyes Heir
desc: Born with the Six Eyes, which see cursed energy to the atom. Their techniques waste almost nothing, but the eyes tire quickly.
traits: Spells cost 10% less mana
See invisible creatures and cursed energy (all spells' projectiles glow)
Bright light gives Blindness for 1 s every 30 s unless you wear a blindfold or helmet

abilities.name: Blindfold
abilities.text: Put the blindfold on: lose the light penalty and see every living thing within 24 blocks through walls for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Efficient Flow
abilities.text: Your next 3 spells cost no mana. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Read the Technique
abilities.text: Look at a mob or player: learn its health, armour and what it's weak to. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Infinity Step
abilities.text: Teleport to the block you look at (12 blocks). 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Float
abilities.text: Hover in place for 6 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lapse: Blue
abilities.text: Pull every enemy within 8 blocks of the spot you look at into its centre. 60 s cooldown.

name: Shadow Clan Heir
source: Megumi Fushiguro, the Zen'in Ten Shadows
desc: Heir to a technique that draws shikigami from shadow. They start with dogs and frogs, and some never find out what the tenth shadow is.
traits: Shadows are pockets: 9 extra storage slots while in light below 8
Dogs and wolves are friendly
Must have both hands free (no shield) to summon

abilities.name: Divine Dogs
abilities.text: Summon two shadow dogs that track and fight for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Toad
abilities.text: Summon a toad that pulls you or an item to safety with its tongue. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Nue
abilities.text: Summon a great owl that carries you through the air for 8 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Sink
abilities.text: Sink into your own shadow and move through the ground for 5 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Max Elephant
abilities.text: Summon an elephant that floods a 6-block area with water. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rabbit Escape
abilities.text: A swarm of shadow rabbits hides you: enemies lose their target and you're invisible for 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

name: Puppet Shell
desc: A frail body that can't leave its bed, piloting a cursed puppet across the world. Every limb is a gun, a blade or a tool.
traits: Your body is the puppet: +6 armour, immune to poison and drowning
Use iron and redstone to heal (2 per item)
Can't eat for food (hunger is always full, saturation never rises): no food buffs

abilities.name: Remote Eye
abilities.text: Send a tiny drone up to 32 blocks to scout for 15 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Thrusters
abilities.text: Fly upward for 3 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Built-in Tools
abilities.text: Your arm becomes any tool (pickaxe, axe, shovel) of iron grade for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Puppet Repair
abilities.text: Repair the item in your hand by 20% with iron. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Signal Relay
abilities.text: Talk to any player in the same world through chat, even far away, and see their direction for 30 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Ultra Cannon
abilities.text: Charge 2 s and fire a beam 16 blocks for 10 damage. 90 s cooldown.

name: Vow-Sworn
desc: Folk who live by binding vows. They give something up and get more back. They are the most dangerous when they make a promise.
traits: Each day you choose a vow at dawn: 10% more damage, or 10% less damage taken
Ring of Promises and vow items work twice as strongly
Breaking a vow (dying) costs 10% of your experience

abilities.name: Sworn Restriction
abilities.text: For 30 s, you can't sprint, but your spells deal 30% more. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reveal Technique
abilities.text: Tell the mob you're fighting your technique: your next 3 attacks deal 20% more. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Pact
abilities.text: Bind an ally: while within 16 blocks of each other, both heal 1 every 5 s for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Oath of Return
abilities.text: Promise to come back: mark a spot, and after you die you respawn there once within 30 minutes. 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Give and Take
abilities.text: Spend 4 health to refill 30% mana, or 30% mana to heal 4. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Simple Domain
abilities.text: For 6 s, enemies within 3 blocks that you haven't hit yet are struck back when they swing. 60 s cooldown.

name: Angelborn
desc: Hosts of a being that hunts techniques. Their light unmakes cursed energy, and they have little patience for anything unholy.
traits: Undead and cursed spirits take 15% more damage from you
Wings: slow falling while sneaking
Your own Cursed Fate techniques cost 25% more

abilities.name: Jacob's Ladder
abilities.text: A beam of light from the sky erases every active effect on the target, good or bad. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Wings
abilities.text: Fly freely for 6 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Halo of Truth
abilities.text: Reveal every invisible or disguised creature within 24 blocks for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.text: Cure an ally of every curse and harmful effect, healing 4. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sanctum
abilities.text: Mark a 6-block area for 2 minutes where domains and barriers can't open. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Technique Erasure
abilities.text: The enemy you look at can't cast spells or techniques for 5 s. 2 min cooldown.
